summary: Sound and voice night for the geography channel: our Shorts speak at about 217 words a minute against the references' 185, and the music sits about 31 dB under the voice. I queued both as look challengers and added 2 topics (Australia's Dingo Fence, Canada's lakes).
why: All 5 reference Shorts speak at 150-194 wpm (median 185, which is also the recipe's own number), while our last 8 run 203-226, so a slower pace goes on the weekly-loop list. Both new topics have references (3.48M and 3.49M views) that beat their channel's 2.09M subscribers, and both are in categories the feed didn't have.
